mechanism: Both drugs can cause hypotension and hyperkalemia; spironolactone is a potassium-sparing diuretic while guanfacine is a centrally-acting alpha-2 agonist that may reduce renal potassium excretion.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and renal function regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if potassium levels become elevated or blood pressure control is inadequate.
